Palestinian Islamic Jihad's statement: 

The Al-Quds Brigades mourn the martyr Imam Ali Khamenei, leader of the Islamic Revolution in Iran, and his fellow martyred leaders.

With the highest expressions of pride and honor, we mourn to the nation the martyr of Palestine, His Eminence Sayyed Ali Khamenei, an exceptional commander on the path to Jerusalem, and his fellow martyred leaders, after a decades-long journey of faith, awareness, and revolution marked by wise leadership of the Islamic Revolution in Iran. Under his guidance, Iran became a powerful force standing against global arrogance.

Today, Imam Ali Khamenei falls as a martyr in what the group describes as the clearest battle of the nation against the “Zionist-American project,” which it accuses of seeking to subjugate the region. While some states sought U.S. protection, the statement says Khamenei stood firmly in opposition, rejecting American dominance.

The statement praises Khamenei’s insistence on the nation’s right to possess weapons, power, and technology to confront what it calls aggression led by “the criminals Trump and Netanyahu.” It highlights his support for Palestinian armed groups, including providing weapons and backing throughout successive conflicts with Israel. The group claims he restored the concepts of jihad and martyrdom to Islam and confronted contemporary “tyrants.”

It says Khamenei was killed during the month of Ramadan and frames his death as martyrdom on the path to Jerusalem, aligning him with resistance movements in Palestine, Lebanon, Iraq, Yemen, Syria, and Iran.

The statement argues that assassinating leaders has historically failed to stop resistance movements and accuses Western powers of trying to impose a Zionist-American order on the region. It asserts that Iran has the right to respond to what it calls a heinous crime.

Addressing the United States and the West, the group says that power and arrogance do not determine history and that attempts to eliminate the Palestinian cause will intensify conflict rather than bring peace. It rejects normalization with Israel, stating that the future of the nation and Palestine remains tied to armed struggle.

The Al-Quds Brigades extend condolences to Iran’s leadership, the so-called Axis of Resistance, and supporters worldwide, congratulating Khamenei on attaining martyrdom. The group pledges to continue what it describes as the path of resistance until Israel’s elimination, ending with the slogan: “Our martyrs… glory to you, and death to your enemies. It is jihad—victory or martyrdom.”
